message.text: Separate late-concern branch: cancellation has not started. The company declines this approval after a new report of an alarm dependency. Do not send this approval again. The service case remains open for continuity review and permitted billing help.

reasons.explanation: A new report of an alarm dependency arrived before commitment. The cancellation has not started.
reasons.required_next_step: The service continuity team reviews the report. This approval is finally declined: never resend it. Any later revised operation needs a new user decision and all required authority checks.

declined.reason: A newly reported alarm dependency needs review before this cancellation can proceed.

alternative.instructions: Ask the service continuity team to review the alarm dependency. If the concern is resolved and you still want cancellation, ask for new terms to review.
